name: copy-button
title: Copy Button
description: Copy Button is a free React copy to clipboard button for Next.js and Tailwind CSS whose copy icon morphs into a check while a green layer spreads from the point you pressed, with a red cross for failed copies, a string or async function as the value, icon and label variants, solid and ghost looks, three sizes and five tones.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)
theme.font-display: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

light.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

dark.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/copy-button.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add copy-button.
